context.transcript:
Hi, I'm calling to make sure your store's open right now.
I want to stop by and get some assistance with the smartphone I bought from you.
Yes, we're open.
But what's the problem?
I can't send or receive text messages.
I leave on a work trip tomorrow and I need to be able to text my colleagues while I'm traveling.
Oh, you must have the P30 smartphone.
A lot of customers with that phone have had the same problem.
Why don't we try to fix it right now over the phone?
That way you won't have to come to the store.
I'm already on my way there.
Okay.
It shouldn't take long to fix.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我打电话来确认一下您的店现在是否营业。
我想过来帮您处理一个从您这里买的智能手机的问题。
是的，我们开门了。
但什么问题？
我无法发送或接收短信。
我明天要去出差，在旅途中需要能给我的同事发短信。
哦，您一定是P30智能手机。
很多使用这款手机的顾客都有同样的问题。
我们现在通过电话试着修好它如何？
这样您就不用来店里了。
我已经正在往那里走。
好的。
修复应该不会花太长时间。
